entries.name: 1688 Cancel Order
entries.description: Request cancellation of an eligible 1688 order before fulfillment continues. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes. Cancellation is not a refund. Eligibility depends on the current 1688 order state.

entries.name: 1688 Confirm Receive
entries.description: Confirm receipt of a delivered 1688 order after checking the goods. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes.

entries.name: 1688 Create Order
entries.description: Submit a 1688 procurement order using the selected products, SKUs, and delivery details. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes.

entries.name: 1688 Invoice Amount
entries.description: Check the invoiceable amount for a 1688 order before applying for an invoice. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes.

entries.name: 1688 Invoice Apply
entries.description: Apply for an invoice for eligible 1688 orders and review the result for each order. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes. Inspect every successList and failedList item. INVOICE_ALREADY_APPLIED means already invoiced. Issued invoices cannot be rolled back here.

entries.name: 1688 Logistics
entries.description: Retrieve shipping information for a 1688 order to track its fulfillment. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes.

entries.name: 1688 Logistics Trace
entries.description: Review the tracking events and delivery progress for a 1688 order. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes.

entries.name: 1688 Order Detail
entries.description: Read an order belonging to the current 1688 buyer, including orders placed directly on 1688. Uses the currently authenticated Nexscope user's 1688 buyer authorization. Orders are read live through the existing 1688 connection. The buyer identity comes from the server, and results are not cached.

entries.name: 1688 Order List
entries.description: List one page of the current buyer's 1688 orders. Current and historical tables are paged separately. Uses the currently authenticated Nexscope user's 1688 buyer authorization. Orders are read live through the existing 1688 connection. The buyer identity comes from the server, and results are not cached.

entries.name: 1688 Order Preview
entries.description: Preview a 1688 order to review items, shipping details, and payable amounts before submission. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes. Stop on status=false even if the envelope succeeds. Totals are cents; cargo prices are CNY yuan.

entries.name: 1688 Order Status
entries.description: Check the current status of a 1688 procurement order after submission. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes.

entries.name: 1688 Payment URL
entries.description: Get a payment link for a 1688 order so you can complete payment yourself. Requires an ACTIVE, unexpired 1688 authorization owned by the current user. Procurement responses are live; do not cache or automatically retry writes. Returns a payment link only; never opens it or pays automatically.

entries.name: 1688 Bestselling Products

entries.name: 1688 Product Detail
entries.description: Retrieve public 1688 product, SKU, pricing, logistics, and supplier details. Retail prices apply to one piece only when present; missing retailPrice must not be inferred from wholesale prices. CNY and foreignCurrency values differ. Confirm actual prices with order preview.

entries.name: 1688 Product Search

entries.name: 1688 Receive Address List
